The Devil Reached Toward the Sky is a non-fiction book by American journalist Garrett M. Graff. It was published by Avid Reader Press on August 5, 2025. It is an oral history of the Manhattan Project and its deadly consequences.
Reception
James Robins of The Washington Post called it "a handsome book", but called its sources "incomplete." Publishers Weekly called it "a stunning account that brings to the fore the nuclear saga’s surreal combination of ingenuity, fate, and terror."
